This application is a virtual keyboard. Go to the system settings by clicking on the button below and enable My-Keyboard.
This is a free and open source application. Based on Unexpected-Keyboard. You can find the source code on GitHub.
After enabling, you can try the keyboard here:
Press Shift at the beginning of a sentence
Switch to the next in the list
Show the input method picker (long press)
Size of characters displayed on the keyboard (%.2fx)
Select keys to add to the keyboard
Play a short sound when a key is pressed
You can lock any modifier by holding it
Double tap on shift for caps lock
Layout when typing numbers, dates, and phone numbers
When a physical keyboard is connected
Enter the best suggestion by pressing space
Move the cursor by swiping on the space bar
Enable word completion and spell checking
Distance of characters in the corners of the keys (%s)
Lightweight and privacy-conscious virtual keyboard for Android.

The main feature is that you can type more characters by swiping the keys towards the corners.

This application was originally designed for programmers using Termux.
Now perfect for everyday use.

This application contains no ads and is Open Source.
